service.description: What a call's page shows of recording: the policy (enabled, ackRequired), whether the current user may record (canRecord), the call's recording going now (recording: callRecordingId, state recording or paused, pauseReason, kind, startedDate; null when none), and this leg's notice (myConsent: noticed, ackRequired, acknowledged, withdrawn). A guest passes their credential. A call the user cannot see is "not found".

parameter.name: encrypted
parameter.description: The call is end-to-end encrypted (W8): it cannot be recorded

service.description: Start recording an active call (a host of it, with call_recording_enabled on). kind: perTrack (each track and the mixed audio, the default) or mixed (the mixed audio only). Every current leg gets the notice, logged in CallRecordingConsent; the starter's own leg counts as acknowledged. With call_recording_ack_required it starts paused until every current leg acknowledged. A call already being recorded answers that recording (repeated).
Stop the call's recording (a host): the media node closes and stores its last segments. By callRecordingId, or the one going in callSessionId.
Pause the call's recording (a host); its segments so far are closed and stored.
Resume a recording the host paused: it records again in a new period of segments, unless the policy holds it paused (a current leg has not acknowledged, or one withdrew).

The current user's leg in the call (a guest's by its credential) acknowledges the recording notice (a click; a phone presses 1 instead, ack#LegRecordingNotice). A withdrawal before is taken back. When every current leg has acknowledged, a recording held for that resumes.
The current user's leg (a guest's by its credential) withdraws its consent: the recording pauses while that leg is in the call; the call goes on. Acknowledging again takes the withdrawal back.

Internal: the hook that gives a leg that is not a browser (a phone number or a SIP device) the recording notice: a prompt played to it by its SIP engine (VoiceServices.notify#PhoneLeg: the recording tone, with ackRequired the acknowledgement tone that asks for 1, then call_recording_prompt_audio when set). Its answer comes back as ack#LegRecordingNotice. Browser and guest legs get the rtc recording frame instead, so this does nothing for them.

Internal (VoiceServices.note#PhoneLeg, when a phone leg presses 1): that leg acknowledges the notice of the recording going in its call, logged in its CallRecordingConsent with the method dtmf (CamDtmf); a recording held for acknowledgements resumes when every current leg has one. Only while a recording asks for acknowledgements and the leg has not given one; at any other time the key is the call's (acknowledged false). Withdrawing by phone is hanging up.

The recordings the current user may read (theirs, and those of calls they host), newest first, of one call or all: each with the call's people, its state, length, error, whether the user may delete it, and its segments by period ({period, segments: [{callRecordingSegmentId, trackKind, source, name, contentType, startOffsetMs, durationMs, segmentSeq, byteSize}]}) for a player that plays a period's tracks together.

One stored segment of a recording the current user may read, for a download transition (which sends the location): location, contentType, fileName, byteSize. Anyone else gets "not found" for the same segment.
Delete a recording that is not going (its owner only): its files, segments, tracks, notices and the recording.

The recording job (hourly): recordings past their retentionUntilDate are deleted, files and rows; recovery: a recording still going whose call ended or whose media node stopped fails ("the recorder stopped"), a segment that was not stored is removed with any partial file, and files under the recordings' root that no recording row names (an upload whose rows rolled back) are deleted. Each item is on its own: one that fails is logged and the rest go on.
Internal: one item of expire#Recordings (itemKind retention, stale, failedSegment or orphanFiles).

Internal (Calls.js, in its transaction): a leg of a call being recorded was bound to a socket (change legBound: a late joiner gets the notice, logged, and the policy is checked again), left (legLeft: its tracks end, and a recording held for its acknowledgement may resume), or the call ended (ended: its recordings stop). Failure tolerant: an error is logged, never returned, so the call's own change goes on.

Internal (FileServices): the bytes the stored files of the recordings userId owns take. They count toward the quota of that user's personal drive, with its files: start#Recording refuses (quotaFull) when it is full, and a recording stops when it fills it.

Internal (the media node's recorder): a closed segment file at tempPath (under runtime/tmp/call-recording) is stored at dbresource://moqui/call/recording/(callRecordingId)/(segment id).(ogg or webm) through store#RecordingFile, with its track (made the first time: by leg and source, or the mix) and segment rows. trackEnded: the track's last segment (its leg left, or the recording stopped). A segment of a recording that is gone or failed is dropped with its file. On a local node, a segment its edge node's recorder queued comes as fromLocation, the queue's copy of its file, instead of tempPath (receive#EdgeRecording).

parameter.name: fromLocation
parameter.description: Where this node's edge link queue keeps a received item's content (dbresource://moqui/edge/content/in/), for a segment of an edge node's recorder

service.description: Internal: moves a recorder's spooled file (tempPath, which must be under the runtime's tmp/call-recording) to contentLocation (under dbresource://moqui/call/recording/), and deletes the spooled file. byteSize is what was stored. A path outside the spool, or a location outside the recordings' root, is refused. Or fromLocation, the content of an item this node's edge link queue received (under dbresource://moqui/edge/content/in/; plans/Edge-Node.md §5.4), copied to contentLocation; the queue removes its copy. Any other location is refused.

Internal (the media node's recorder): the recorder ended on its own. outcome failed (a full queue, a file or store error: the recording fails with errorText as lastErrorText, its partial files already removed) or limit (it reached call_recording_max_mb: it stops, with that as lastErrorText). Either way the call goes on and every leg is told the recording stopped.

On a local node, the edge link's queue kind callRecording (MoquiDefaultConf.xml edge, plans/Edge-Node.md §5.4): what its edge node's recorder, the media node of this node's calls, made. The payload is a segment ({op: 'segment', parameters} of store#RecordingSegment, its file the item's content at contentLocation) or the recorder's end ({op: 'end', callRecordingId, outcome, errorText} of note#RecorderEnd), queued in the recording's conversation, so the end never overtakes a segment. Run only for the queue, as _edge_; an error rolls the receipt back and the item is tried again.
